core.description: Always active — no config flag required

jira.description: Jira ticket ingestion, search, comment, and transition

github.description: Repo lookup, branch creation, and PR creation via GitHub REST API
github.notes: WebFetch drives the GitHub REST API; Bash handles git clone/checkout/push

observability_newrelic.description: New Relic log and metric queries via NerdGraph GraphQL API
observability_newrelic.notes: POST to https://api.newrelic.com/graphql with NRQL queries

observability_azure.description: Azure Application Insights KQL queries via Azure Monitor REST API

observability_cloudwatch.description: AWS CloudWatch Logs Insights queries via AWS CLI
observability_cloudwatch.notes: Uses AWS CLI via Bash. Credentials resolved from env vars (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID + AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY) or AWS_SESSION_TOKEN for assumed roles. Service-to-log-group mapping read from observability.cloudwatch.serviceLogGroupMap.

knowledgebase_confluence.description: Confluence page search and full-page fetch

knowledgebase_sharepoint.description: SharePoint document search and fetch via Microsoft Graph API
knowledgebase_sharepoint.notes: POST to https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/search/query; auth via Azure AD client-credentials grant

knowledgebase_publish.description: Publish the RCA document to the configured knowledgebase at the end of the workflow
knowledgebase_publish.notes: Confluence: use MCP createConfluencePage if mcp.atlassian.enabled, else REST POST /wiki/rest/api/content. SharePoint: always WebFetch via Microsoft Graph PUT /drive/root:<path>:/content. Publish failure is non-fatal — report and continue.

database.description: Read-only queries across one or more DB servers for RCA evidence
database.notes: All engines use Bash (already in core). readOnly must be true per connection. allowedEnvironments is checked globally before querying any connection. One connection entry per server — add as many as needed.
